expo.name: Crosscare Concierge
expo.description: Crosscare Concierge is your AI-powered pregnancy companion that provides personalized health insights, tracks your pregnancy journey, and offers 24/7 support through an intelligent doula chatbot. Monitor your health metrics, log meals and activities, capture pregnancy memories, and get expert guidance throughout your maternal health journey.

infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: We use your microphone for conversating with Doula chatbot using your voice.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: This app needs access to read your health data including steps, heart rate, and sleep information to provide personalized health insights.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: We use your photos to help you track your pregnancy journey, show it on your profile and give you analysis of your pregnancy journey.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Crosscare Concierge to access your camera to capture your pregnancy journey
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Crosscare Concierge to access your microphone to chat with Doula chatbot

plugins.healthSharePermission: Allow Crosscare Concierge to access your health data to provide personalized insights and recommendations.
plugins.healthSharePermissionDescription: This app requires access to your health data to provide personalized insights and recommendations.
